cc_aeroworks.ponder.desk_network.header: Install and share a desk computer
cc_aeroworks.ponder.desk_network.text_1: Sneak-use an ordinary console and place a CC:Tweaked computer in the shared slot.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.desk_network.text_2: Adjacent, equally facing desks form one row while retaining their positions, modules and attachments.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.desk_network.text_3: Every desk shows the same slot. If its host is removed, the computer moves to a remaining desk.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.desk_network.text_4: The row now has one owner computer and one searchable network.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.desk_network.text_5: Sneak-use opens the overview; Computer opens the terminal and the shared workspace tabs.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.desk_network.text_6: Removing the final desk drops the computer with its ID, label and files intact.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.peripheral_search.te: Direct attachments are recorded with the desk position and side where they are connected.
Remote desks keep their own addresses, so equal peripheral types remain distinguishable.
Sources lists peripherals, telemetry and optional radar inputs in one refreshable view.
peripherals.find(type) returns the direct handle when there is exactly one match.
For multiple matches, use the position and side keys or call peripherals.findAll(type).
Channels lists native controls and Drive By Wire targets without hiding their owning desk.
Refresh after topology changes; attach and detach events keep running programs synchronized.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.desk_diagnostics.tex: Open Channels or call controls.getChannels() to discover writable controls in the active desk row.
Address the target by desk ID, socket and native channel name—even when it is on another desk.
controls.override(..., 12) moves the yoke and publishes the commanded Redstone Link strength in the same tick.
A HARD override rejects manual movement until the program releases that channel.
controls.release() returns authority to the player and the unattended control springs back safely.
Computer shutdown, invalid topology or a removed module releases every affected override automatically.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.display_crafting.tex: Press a Normal Monitor into the compact two-digit display.
Press an Advanced Monitor into the wider three-digit display.
Both results are flat mounted modules, not standalone monitor blocks.
With Create: Radars loaded, deploy its monitor onto the matching display to make a radar variant.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.display_mounting.tex: Two compact displays can fill the left and right sockets together.
A compact display also fits the center big socket.
The wide display requires the big socket and cannot cover both small sockets.
Each slot keeps its own resolution; touch and draw require the row's active computer to be Advanced.
Select the desk by position and the display by socket name or number.
peripherals.find("ControlDesk") returns all desk handles keyed by position.
setDisplayText and setDisplayNumber switch the chosen surface to text mode.
Read getDisplaySize before drawing; pixel density can differ per slot.
Pixel calls enter raster mode; clearDisplay resets the surface for the next frame.
An Advanced computer enables touch, draw streams and bound scripts on that display.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_controller.tex: Mount a small or large Radar Display in the desk that should receive the radar picture.
Use the Create: Radars Data Link on the Network Filterer first to store the source network.
Use the same Data Link on the Radar Display desk; an ordinary display is not a valid endpoint.
Create: Radars checks range and places the physical Data Link block on the desk.
The desk now behaves as a native monitor endpoint for that filtered radar network.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_direct.header: Read and recover a radar display
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_direct.text_1: The connected desk resolves its Network Filterer and radar through Create: Radars NetworkData.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_direct.text_2: Sweep and contacts follow the group's DetectionConfig and selected target.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_direct.text_3: The large display also shows the native contact legend and selection marker.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_direct.text_4: Every Radar Display desk needs its own physical Data Link, even in one desk row.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_direct.text_5: Breaking that link removes the endpoint and replaces stale contacts with the disconnected state.
cc_aeroworks.ponder.radar_direct.text_6: Restore the physical Data Link to reconnect; the live sweep and contacts return automatically.
